raw.query: SELECT window_name, lead_s, p99_ms FROM provenance.factorial_cell WHERE policy = 'reactive' AND window_name IN ('burst1', 'steady24h') AND lead_s IN (15, 300) AND rho = 15 ORDER BY window_name, lead_s;
raw.claimed: Slow ramps (burst1, the calm day) are reactive-scalable at any tested lead
raw.evidence: In the reactive policy for slow ramps (burst1 and steady24h), p99 encoder delays are well below the 1000 ms SLA threshold at all tested leads (15s to 300s): burst1 p99 is 588.4 ms (L=15) and 637.7 ms (L=300); steady24h p99 is 548.4 ms (L=15) and 884.1 ms (L=300).
